headline: John Byrne, an ‘X-Men’ Artist, Returns to Rewrite the Story His Way
context: After creative differences led him to step away from the characters that made him famous decades ago, John Byrne calls “Elsewhen” his swan song. He’s not going quietly.

sources.name: The New York Times
